exposure: Implementation of a surgical site infection surveillance programme
outcome: Economic burden of surgical site infection (SSI)
Costs of SSI treatment and management
cohort: Women undergoing caesarean section in National Health Service hospitals.
finding: Surgical site infection after caesarean section incurs a significant economic burden to the health service, and implementation of a surveillance programme with feedback offers a potentially effective means to reduce infection risk, improve patient experience, and generate savings.
mod_finding: Surveillance of surgical site infections following caesarean section with data feedback offers a potentially effective means to reduce infection risk, improve patient experience, and save money for the health service.
